annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2009/1/EC of 7 January 2009 amending Directive 2005/64/EC on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their reusability, recyclability and recoverability
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 2009/1/EC of 7 January 2009 amending Directive 2005/64/EC on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their reusability, recyclability and recoverability
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive adapting the EU type-approval directive on motor vehicle reusability, recyclability and recoverability to technical progress. It requires manufacturers to show supplier contractual arrangements and procedures ensuring end-of-life vehicle material compliance, using ISO 9000/14000 quality programmes. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex IV to Directive 2005/64/EC amended with new paragraph 4.
Manufacturers must demonstrate supplier contractual arrangements ensuring compliance with ELV Directive Article 4(2)(a).
Manufacturers must set procedures to communicate, monitor, collect and verify supplier data.
ISO 9000/14000 or equivalent quality assurance programme required.
From 1 January 2012 Member States must refuse type-approval for non-compliant new vehicle types.
